description: Close an ask you posted (or the person you act for posted) and bring its unspent money back to the poster's own account. What answers still waiting are owed stays on the ask, so they can still be reviewed and paid. Previews by default: what comes back, what stays and why. Call again with confirm: true to sign. Refused for an ask somebody else posted.

collectionId.description: The ask's number, as on its page (/t/<number>).

confirm.description: Leave out to preview what comes back. true signs.

network.description: Which deployment: `mainnet` is the real network (real money); `testnet` is the sandbox (play money, a dry run).

name: close_ask
title: Close an ask and take its money back
